setupPrompt.intro: Help me set up Nowledge Mem locally for Kila:
setupPrompt.step1: Confirm my operating system, then check whether Nowledge Mem is installed and running.
setupPrompt.step2: If it is not installed, walk me through getting the desktop client from https://mem.nowledge.co. Do not download or run unknown installers on my behalf.
setupPrompt.step3: Once it is running, check the local service at http://127.0.0.1:14242/health. Configure localhost only — no remote services.
setupPrompt.step4: If the nmem CLI is available, run nmem status to verify. If it is not, do not force an install — Kila can reach the local HTTP service directly.
setupPrompt.step5: Back in Kila, go to Settings → Memory and click “Detect & Enable”.
setupPrompt.step6: Finally, explain that Kila's memory is managed entirely by Nowledge: without Nowledge configured, memory stays off and no memory files are written locally.
